Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




You will join Valmet's Global Tissue Services automation team as a software engineer working on tissue machine modernization, focusing on software engineering, testing, commissioning and start‑up activities using Valmet DNA and occasionally Siemens PLCs and Pilz controllers.

You will design and develop PLC/DCS automation software, produce documentation, participate in FAT, commissioning and start‑ups, and support sales, procurement and engineering teams to meet delivery, hourly and cost targets.

The role requires a B.Sc or M.Sc in automation or equivalent experience, more than five years in a similar role, PLC/DCS experience (e.g. Valmet DNA, Siemens, Allen‑Bradley), proficiency in Swedish and English, and willingness to travel 0–80 days per year.

The position can be based in Sweden or Finland (preferably Jyväskylä, Tikkurila or Karlstad), involves international travel, requires background and alcohol/drug checks, and applications must be submitted by October 29, 2026.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

Are you ready to take the next step in your engineering career? We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Global Tissue Services automation engineering team.

At Valmet, we are shaping the future of sustainable solutions through innovation, collaboration, and a seamless lifecycle approach. Join us as we move forward with our renewed strategy to Lead the Way. This means pioneering smarter technologies, expanding our service capabilities, and delivering customer value across the entire lifecycle, from raw material to finished product. If you're ready to make a real impact in a dynamic, future-focused environment, we invite you to grow with us.



In this role, you will work with automation systems for tissue machine modernization projects in a global and collaborative environment. Your daily work will consist of diverse and technically challenging tasks, where you will have the opportunity to take initiative, contribute to customer performance improvements, and support the continuous development of our technologies and ways of working. Your work will include software engineering, testing, commissioning, training, and start-up activities, while contributing to both customer performance and the continuous development of our technologies and ways of working. As a software engineer, you will primarily work with Valmet DNA tools, while also having the opportunity to broaden your expertise with Siemens PLCs and Pilz safety controllers when needed.


The location for this position is flexible and can be based in Sweden or Finland, with a preference for Jyväskylä, Tikkurila, or Karlstad. International travel is part of the role, offering opportunities for hands-on impact and global collaboration.


Your main responsibilities


Design and develop automation system software (PLC/DCS) and produce the related documentation.

Timely completing engineering activities with respect to delivery time, hourly budget and the target cost.

Support mechanical and process engineering teams in solution selection.

Support the sales team by providing expertise and answers to software engineering‑related questions.

Support procurement team if needed to evaluate suppliers and brands.

Participate in FAT and start-ups.

Participate in commissioning, testing and starting up of equipment.


What do we expect from you?


B.Sc or M.Sc degree in automation engineering or equivalent experience

More than five years of experience in a similar role

Experience with PLC/DCS systems (e.g. Valmet DNA, Siemens, Allen-Bradley)

Industry knowledge

Experience with Eplan/CADS is an additional advantage

Proficiency in Swedish and English

Self-driven and collaborative mindset

Willingness to travel 0-80 days per year


What can you expect from us?

In return, we offer you an exciting and rewarding role in a global industry-leading company, supported by Valmet’s extensive international network. You will work in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment where innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, develop your expertise, and grow professionally in an international setting with strong support throughout your career journey. Our onboarding process and dedicated team will support and guide you as you start in your new role.

Want to know more?

Did we catch your interest? If yes, please join our team and send your application via the link provided as soon as possible but no later than October 29, 2026. For further information about the position, please contact Jussi Peltomäki Manager, Automation Engineering, Tissue Machines Services [email omitted]. Please note that we will not accept applications by
e-mail.


We perform background checks and alcohol and drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.


When everything works together Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. With over 19,000 professionals around the world, we are the leading global developer and supplier of technologies, automation and services for the pulp, paper and energy industries, and serve an even wider base of process industries with our automation systems and flow control solutions. Our commitment to moving our customers’ performance forward requires creativity, technological innovations, service know-how – and above all, teamwork.
Join the team! www.valmet.com/careers

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




You will coordinate and execute global marine automation service jobs and support customers as a Service Coordinator/Engineer.

You will manage quotations, orders and work orders in the ERP system and follow up open warranty cases.

The role requires a technical background or equivalent experience (preferably in marine automation), ERP/CRM familiarity, strong organisation and fluent English.

The position involves occasional travel, acting as substitute for the Service Manager with participation in a 24/7 emergency support line, and includes benefits and flexible working.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

Are you a service-minded engineer who strive to find custom made solutions to help customers? We have a new opportunity for you!

Valmet is known for its reliable marine automation. We have been intensively present onboard all types of ships where our solutions play an integral role. Our target is to make the vessels greener, more efficient and more profitable, thanks to the use of advanced automation and scrubber solutions. We are now looking for a Service Coordinator/Engineer within Marine Automation.

Your Main Responsibilities

As a Service Coordinator/Engineer your key duties lay within:


Support and service our Marine customers.

Planning/coordinating/administrating service jobs globally by using our extensive service network.

Follow-up on open warranty cases.

Maintaining and updating the quotation, ensuring traceability and accuracy.

Managing orders from quotation to invoicing, creating work orders in the ERP system, and coordinating timelines with involved parties.

Planning and conduct/ execute service on demand, upgrades. Supporting the execution team.

To be substitute for Service Manager and be part of 24/7 emergency support line.


What do we expect from you?

We’re seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-layered global environment. The ideal candidate will have:


A technical background or equivalent experience in customer service or project coordination, preferably within the marine automation industry.

Experience with ERP systems (e.g., Infor LN) and CRM systems.

Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).

An accurate, structured approach to work with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

A proactive, can-do attitude and eagerness to learn.




Experience of working on ships with electrical or data programming is preferred.



We also believe that you have an engineering background, with PLC and/or automation programming. Knowledge of marine ships engine systems is considered as an asset.



This position requires some traveling at times to customer, ships or Marine floating devices. You need to be able to have English as a working language, any other additional languages are considered an asset. It is also beneficial if you are experienced in working abroad.

We offer

In addition to benefitting from a stimulating work environment based on continuous improvement and teamwork, our employees have access to a full range of benefits: group insurance coverage, professional development support and a pension plan, to name a few. We also offer flexible working arrangements.

Additional information

For more information about this position, you are welcome to contact Global Service Manager, Bartosz Uzieblo, [email omitted]. Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail.

Apply as soon as possible, but latest October 26, 2026.

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




The Director, Pricing & Availability is a strategic global leadership role in Valmet's Flow Control MRO & Services to strengthen pricing, availability, and offering management.

You will lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 pricing, availability, and analytics professionals, preferably based in Finland but with other Valmet locations considered.

Key responsibilities include developing and executing global pricing and availability strategies, pricing governance and analytics, improving end-to-end processes, and acting as business owner for commercial systems such as Salesforce and Power BI.

The role requires a Master’s degree, 10+ years of relevant experience, strong analytical and stakeholder management skills, fluency in English, and applications are due by October 26, 2026.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

Are you looking for a next career step?

Valmet is a global leader in flow control solutions and services. Our valves, pumps and valve automation technologies are known for quality, reliability and highest safety. Our customers operate in pulp, paper and board industry, mining and metals, chemicals, refining, energy and many other process industries. With our market-leading expertise, products and services we are committed to bring our customer's business forward.



We are now looking for a Director, Pricing & Availability to join our Flow Control MRO & Services Business Unit. In this strategic global leadership role, you will play a key part in strengthening our pricing, availability, and offering management capabilities while leading a team of experienced professionals. Working closely with sales, product management, operations, supply chain, and finance teams, you will drive initiatives that improve business performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term competitiveness across our global organization



You will lead a team of approximately 5–6 experienced professionals, including pricing, availability, and analytics experts, primarily located in Finland. The team plays a central role in defining pricing governance, commercial analytics, product availability strategies, and business performance management across the global Flow Control organization.



This position in preferred to be in Finland but we are also open for other Valmet major location globally.

Your responsibilities


Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of pricing, availability, and offering management professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Drive the development and execution of global pricing and availability strategies that support business growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

Lead pricing governance, analytics, and value-based pricing initiatives to improve margin performance

Own and continuously improve end-to-end processes for pricing, offering management, lead time management, and availability planning.

Lead strategic and operational initiatives that strengthen commercial and operational capabilities across the organization.

Partner with Sales, Product Management, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to achieve business objectives

Drive the development and utilization of commercial analytics, reporting, and performance management tools, including Salesforce and Power BI.

Act as business owner for some of our key commercial systems, tools, and processes, ensuring alignment between business requirements and technology solutions.

Support data-driven decision-making through pricing analytics, market insights, KPI development, and performance reporting.

Build organizational capabilities by developing talent, sharing best practices, and creating scalable processes that support business growth.


Expectations for you


Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Economics, or a related field.

10+ years of relevant experience in pricing, commercial excellence, availability management, offering management, supply chain, or related business functions.

Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams and subject matter experts.

Demonstrated success in driving business transformation and leading cross-functional initiatives.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and influencing capabilities in a global environment.

Strong knowledge of pricing methodologies, commercial analytics, and performance management.

Advanced Microsoft Office, Power BI, and data analytics skills.

Experience with CRM and ERP systems (Salesforce and M3 experience is considered an asset).

Excellent communication skills in English.


To succeed in this role

You combine strong commercial understanding with analytical thinking and operational insight. You are comfortable leading experienced subject matter experts, influencing stakeholders across a global organization, and driving change through data and collaboration. Success in this role requires experience in pricing and availability-related disciplines, strong decision-making capabilities, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable processes and solutions.



We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:


Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through

Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly

Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety

Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value


We offer

This is a unique opportunity to shape critical business capabilities, influence strategic decisions, and drive measurable impact across the business. Valmet offers an inspiring and international work environment where you can collaborate with experts around the world, develop professionally, and contribute to meaningful business outcomes. We value continuous learning, flexible ways of working, and empowering people to grow and succeed.

Additional information

Please fill in the electronic application form with your CV attached as soon as possible, but no later than October 26, 2026. Our recruitment process includes two rounds of interviews, external personality assessments, final interview for the top candidates and may also involve a role-related case assignment.

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




Lead Pressure Parts manufacturing operations in Lapua and Tampere to ensure safe, efficient, high-quality production and improve delivery, productivity, and cost performance.

Manage about 200 manufacturing professionals and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Drive operational excellence by developing and executing manufacturing strategies using Lean, process development, performance management, and new technologies.

Candidates must have a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering or Industrial Management, proven experience leading large manufacturing organizations with Lean expertise, fluency in English, willingness to travel, and submit applications by 8 November 2026.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

Are you ready to take the lead in a global manufacturing environment where people, processes, and performance come together?

We are looking for a Director, Manufacturing, Pressure Parts to lead our production operations in Finland and play a key role in shaping the future of our manufacturing performance and competitiveness. In this position, you will drive operational excellence across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost efficiency while developing a high-performing organization.

As a member of the Global Supply Production Leadership Team, you will contribute to strategic decision-making and collaborate closely with stakeholders across our businesses and supply organization. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on our global manufacturing operations and customer success.

Besides having responsibility of own production, you ensure that we have right subcontracting partner network in place. With deep relationships and partner capability development we will execute our strategy with secured resilience, competitiveness and performance.

Your Responsibilities


Lead and develop Pressure Parts manufacturing operations in Lapua and Tampere, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production.



Develop and execute manufacturing strategies that support business objectives, competitiveness, and long-term growth.



Lead approximately 200 manufacturing professionals and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.



Drive operational excellence through Lean methodologies, process development, performance management, and the implementation of new technologies and ways of working.



Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners to ensure production performance, sustainability, compliance, and delivery excellence.


Expectations for You


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, or another relevant field.



Proven experience leading manufacturing operations and large production organizations in a complex industrial environment.



Strong track record in driving operational excellence through Lean, continuous improvement, and change management initiatives.



Strong business acumen with the

ability to make data-driven decisions that improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.



Fluency in English and the willingness to travel globally when required.


To Succeed in This Role

To be successful in this role, you have extensive experience in a manufacturing leadership position and a strong ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You excel at developing high-performing teams and building strong relationships across functions, businesses, and cultures. You are comfortable leading change, driving transformation, and challenging the status quo to improve performance. Your analytical mindset enables you to translate operational data into actions that create sustainable business results. Most importantly, you are passionate about people leadership and creating an environment where individuals and teams can succeed.



We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles - practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:


Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through.



Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly.



Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety.



Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value.


Want to Know More?

Ready to help shape the future of our manufacturing operations? We'd love to hear from you. Submit your application through Valmet Careers by 8 November 2026.



We will start reviewing applications during the application period. In our recruitment process. We use a variety of selection methods, e.g. video screening, personality questionnaires, ability tests, and interviews.

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




You will own the lifecycle of technical documentation for Flow Control products and ensure accuracy, compliance, and availability.

You will coordinate documentation for new product launches and manage publishing, translation, and cross‑functional collaboration.

The role requires a bachelor’s or master’s degree, at least four years of technical documentation experience, knowledge of industrial equipment, and familiarity with documentation management systems.

You must be self-directed with strong stakeholder communication in English and Finnish, able to handle multiple priorities, willing to travel, and based in Vantaa.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

Are you ready for the next step in your career?

Valmet is a global leader in flow control solutions and services. Our valves, pumps and valve automation technologies are known for quality, reliability and highest safety. Our customers operate in pulp, paper and board industry, mining and metals, chemicals, refining, energy and many other process industries. With our market-leading expertise, products and services we are committed to bring our customer's business forward.



Join us as a Technical Documentation Manager in Vantaa and take ownership of the lifecycle of technical documentation supporting Flow Control products. You will work globally across the organization, collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, and ensure that documentation is accurate, clear, easy to understand and available when needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a self-directed professional who enjoys driving improvements, solving problems, and creating lasting impact.

Your responsibilities


Own the lifecycle management of IMO documentation, technical bulletins, safety manuals, and other product documentation, ensuring content remains accurate, up to date, and aligned with product changes and regulatory requirements.

Coordinate documentation activities for new product launches by working closely with Product Management and R&D to collect technical input, define requirements, and ensure documentation is delivered according to project schedules.

Collaborate across the organization with Marketing Communications, Sales, Service, Customer Support, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure documentation supports both customer needs and business objectives.

Manage publishing and translation processes, working with external partners and internal subject matter experts to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and availability of multilingual documentation.

Drive the continuous development of documentation processes, tools, terminology management, and content reuse practices to improve efficiency, quality, and user experience.

Ensure documentation quality and compliance with applicable standards, safety requirements, directives, and certification needs, while supporting audits and regulatory reviews when required


Expectations for you


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in relevant technical field

4+ years of experience creating, managing, and developing technical documentation, such as user manuals, maintenance instructions, technical bulletins, or similar technical content.

A good understanding of industrial equipment, such as valves, actuators, positioners, or other engineered products, and can translate complex technical information into clear and user-friendly documentation.

Experience with documentation management systems, version control practices, publishing processes, and translation workflows.

You are a strong communicator who can effectively collaborate with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels and build strong relationships throughout the business.

You are self-directed, development-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership while driving improvements and solving challenges proactively.

You perform well under pressure, can manage multiple priorities, and focus on finding practical solutions to problems.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Finnish.

Some travelling is required as part of the role.


To succeed in this role

Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management and the ability to communicate effectively across the entire organization. You combine a structured and self-directed way of working with a continuous improvement mindset and enjoy developing processes, tools, and ways of working. You are comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with multiple priorities and can remain focused on finding solutions when challenges arise. Your ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and connect technical experts with business needs will be essential.



We also expect you to align with Valmet's Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:




Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through

Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly

Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety

Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value


We offer

An opportunity to work in a highly collaborative and international environment where your expertise directly supports product success and customer experience. You will have a central role connecting multiple teams and contributing to the continuous development of documentation practices. We value development-minded professionals, provide modern tools, and support both personal and professional growth.

Additional information

Please fill in the electronic application form with your CV attached as soon as possible, but no later than 4th November.

The Production Coordinator will support daily production operations by managing workforce administration, reporting, working time and system coordination and by liaising with supervisors, payroll and HR.

You will act as the local key user for the Nepton working time system and Abloy OS, review and correct working time transactions, create shift calendars, calculate annual working hours and prepare operational reports.

Required qualifications include relevant education and experience in administration, payroll or production support, strong Excel skills, knowledge of time management systems and the Technology Industry collective agreement, and good Finnish and English.

Candidates should be proactive, systematic and reliable, align with Valmet’s leadership principles, and apply through Valmet Careers by 1st November with selection methods that may include video screening, tests and interviews.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

We are looking for a Production Coordinator to join our Fabrics business in Tampere.

Are you a service-minded and organized professional who enjoys keeping production support processes running smoothly?



In this role, you will support daily production operations workforce administration, reporting, working time management, and system coordination. You will work closely with employees, supervisors, factory management, payroll and HR to ensure smooth and accurate processes.

Your Responsibilities


Act as the local key user for the Nepton working time system, including testing, development, user guidance and system-related changes.

Review and correct working time transactions according to agreed schedules.

Cooperate closely with production supervisors and support employees in working time related matters.

Serve as a contact person between production, payroll and HR teams.

Administer and maintain employee access rights as the key user of the Abloy OS system.

Prepare operational reports.

Calculate annual working hours for different shift systems.

Create and maintain employee shift calendars.

Support continuous improvement of administrative processes and practices within production.


Expectations for You


Relevant education in business administration, finance, or payroll, and experience with time management systems and payroll processes.

Previous experience in coordination, administration or production support activities.

Good understanding of the Technology Industry collective agreement and working time practices.

Strong skills in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

Customer service mindset and strong communication skills.

Ability to work independently and manage tasks according to schedules and deadlines.

Ability to work effectively in a busy environment.

Good Finnish and English language skills.


To Succeed in This Role

You are proactive, systematic and reliable. You enjoy helping others, solving practical issues and ensuring that administrative processes are completed accurately and on time. You can balance routine responsibilities with changing priorities and collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.'



We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through

Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly

Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety

Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value



Want to Know More?

Ready to support the smooth operation of our production organization? We'd love to hear from you. Submit your application through Valmet Careers by the 1st November.

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




Valmet is hiring two Project Engineers for its Hakkila, Vantaa office to manage industrial valve delivery projects and support international customer collaboration.

The role involves clarifying technical requirements, managing technical change requests and documentation, hosting customer inspections, and coordinating stakeholders to ensure project delivery.

Applicants must have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical/Automation or a related field, at least 3+ years of project experience, the ability to read technical drawings, and knowledge of PDM/ERP is an advantage.

Fluency in Finnish and English is required, occasional travel within Europe is expected, and applications are due by 01/11/2026.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

Are you ready for the next step in your career?

Valmet is a global technology leader serving process industries. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Our valves, pumps and valve automation technologies are known for quality, reliability and highest safety. Our customers operate in pulp, paper and board industry, mining and metals, chemicals, refining, energy and many other process industries.



We are now looking for two Project Engineers in our Hakkila, Vantaa office. You will work closely with our customers, project managers, factory operations and global stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. This role offers a unique combination of technical problem-solving, customer interaction and international collaboration while supporting sustainable industrial solutions.

Your responsibilities


Clarify technical requirements for industrial valve delivery projects together with our EPC customers and project managers.

Manage technical change requests, document approvals and final project documentation.

Host customer inspections and site visits and act as a technical expert throughout project execution.

Collaborate with project managers, factory personnel, quality, design, R&D, documentation and inspection teams.

Coordinate information across stakeholders and help ensure projects are delivered according to customer specifications.


Expectations for you


B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Process Automation or another relevant technical field.

3+ years of experience experience working in a project environment and understanding of industrial equipment and processes.

Ability to read technical drawings, machining drawings and technical documentation.

Knowledge of document management systems; PDM and ERP are considered an advantage.

Fluent Finnish and English skills.

Occasional travel within Europe may be required.


To succeed in this role

You are an independent and proactive professional who enjoys taking ownership and moving tasks forward in collaboration with others. You combine technical curiosity with strong communication skills and can confidently interact with customers and inspectors. Your analytical mindset, customer-oriented approach and ability to gather information from multiple stakeholders help you solve complex project challenges.



We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:


Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through

Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly

Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety

Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value


We offer

You will join a supportive and experienced Project Engineering team working with documentation, inspections and customer specifications in an international project environment. The team follows LEAN principles and offers excellent opportunities to learn, grow and develop your expertise. You will collaborate with skilled professionals across multiple functions and gain exposure to global customers and projects. Valmet offers modern tools, local benefits, continuous learning opportunities and career development within a leading global technology company.

Additional information

Please fill in the electronic application form with your CV attached as soon as possible, but no later than 01/11/2026.

The Senior Sales Manager will grow Valmet's global partner business within Energy, Process and Marine Systems, initially focusing on the Middle East, Africa and Central Asia with expected travel of 20–40%.

You will own the full partner lifecycle by identifying growth opportunities, recruiting and onboarding partners, and developing go‑to‑market plans with regional sales teams.

The role requires collaborating with sales, engineering, product management, services, and marketing to support partners in developing and winning customer opportunities.

Candidates should have a Bachelor's or Master's degree, experience in industrial sales or partner management, a solid understanding of industrial automation, and fluent English.

Vuorovastaavavuorossa huolehdit, että myymälässä suoritettavat työt sujuvat suunnitellusti ja aikataulussa. Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Onko sinulla kaupanteon meininkiä? Haluatko mukaan suomalaisen vähittäiskaupan menestystarinaan ja työskentelemään osana asiakaspalveluhenkistä, yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa ja ammattitaitoista joukkoamme? Myymäläpäällikön työssä pääset vaikuttamaan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilökunnan viihtyvyyteen sekä myymälän tulokseen.

Etsimme nyt myymäläpäällikköä johtamaan myymälän myyntiä ja asiakaspalvelua sekä niiden kehittämistä. Vastaat myymälän konseptinmukaisuudesta ja tuloksesta ja johdat henkilökuntaa innostavalla ja kannustavalla otteella esimerkkiä näyttäen varmistaen asiakkaillemme helpon ja inspiroivan ostoympäristön.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Työ on vakituinen ja työaika on 37,5 h/vko.


Taidot ja vaatimukset

Etsimme noin 10 henkilöä työllistävän myymälämme päälliköksi osaavaa ja myymälähenkilökuntaa aktiivisella, läsnä olevalla ja päämäärätietoisella tyylillä ohjaavaa esihenkilöä. Aiempi kokemus ja näytöt päivittäis- ja/tai käyttötavarakaupan menestyksekkäästä hoitamisesta sekä tehtävää tukeva koulutus (esim. merkonomi, tradenomi) ovat edellytys tässä tehtävässä onnistumiselle.

Olet positiivinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen ja osaat johtaa myyntiä yrityksen tunnuslukuja hyödyntäen. Sinulla on kyky innostaa ja kannustaa joukkuettasi työskentelemään yhdessä sovittujen tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi. Toimit johdonmukaisesti, selkeästi ja jämäkästi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää edellä mainittujen asioiden lisäksi asiakaslähtöisyyttä, liiketaloudellista ajattelutapaa sekä kykyä hahmottaa laajoja kokonaisuuksia. Tuotteiden esillepanon ohjaamisessa tarvitset hyvää tilanhahmotuskykyä ja visuaalista silmää. Työ on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä tehdä rohkeasti nopeitakin päätöksiä. Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos haluat päästä kehittämään toimivia rutiineja myymälääsi.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tokmannin myymäläpäällikkönä pääset tekemään vastuullista työtä, jossa sinulla on vapautta tehdä myymälässäsi itsenäisiä myynnin kehittämiseen liittyviä päätöksiä. Porukassamme on mahtava yhteishenki ja tuemme toisiamme onnistumaan työssämme yli myymälärajojen.

Me tokmannilaiset toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ja välitämme ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä. Keskinäisen yhteistyön kulmakivinämme on luottamus ja kunnioitus, ja tähtäämme yhdessä uuden oppimiseen ja kehittymiseen virheitä pelkäämättä.

Vuoron operatiivisesta johtamisesta 💡

Johdat vuoron tekemistä sekä jaat ja priorisoit työtehtäviä.

Huolehdit resurssien, taukojen ja työmäärän sujuvasta toteutumisesta.

Vastaat myymälän avaamiseen ja sulkemiseen liittyvistä tehtävistä.

Ratkaiset vuoron aikana eteen tulevia arjen tilanteita ja huolehdit myymälän turvallisuudesta ja toimintavalmiudesta.

Ratkaiset asiakastilanteita ja käsittelet asiakasreklamaatioita työvuorosi aikana.

Koordinoit tavarakuormien purkua ja huolehdit työn sujuvasta etenemisestä.

Huolehdit muista työvuoron sujuvuuden kannalta tarpeellisista myymälätehtävistä.

As a Senior AI Data Engineer at Nokia you will own end-to-end data engineering to create reliable, linked and AI-ready assets from standards and internal datasets supporting research, standards and patenting.

You will build and operate scalable ingestion, transformation and processing pipelines, strengthen metadata, data quality, lineage and observability, and develop LLM-assisted semantic ingestion and retrieval.

Required skills include strong hands-on Python and production-grade data engineering, distributed processing and data modelling, PostgreSQL or Elasticsearch, Kubernetes and cloud-native CI/CD and monitoring experience.

You will collaborate closely with AI engineers, researchers and standards experts while providing technical guidance and will benefit from Nokia's hybrid work, health support and career development programs.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



The AI & Data Engineering team builds the engineering foundation for Technology Standards’ transformation into an AI-first organization. Our scope spans Agentic AI and AgentOps, data engineering, common software platforms, and compute and simulation capabilities.

Our Data Engineering mission is to ingest and process external standardization data, including 3GPP, O-RAN, JVET, MPEG, Wi-Fi and ITU-R, together with internal high-value datasets, into reliable, linked and AI-ready data assets.

As a Senior AI Data Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of data engineering solutions supporting Q365, Technology Standards Research & Innovation, and Patenting. You will work hands-on across architecture, data pipelines, cloud platforms, metadata, quality and production operations, collaborating closely with AI engineers, researchers, standards experts and patenting stakeholders.

The role combines strong software and data-engineering capabilities with the ability to translate research and business needs into scalable, reliable and production-ready solutions.


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN


Own data solutions from requirements and architecture through deployment, operation and continuous improvement.

Build scalable ingestion, transformation and processing pipelines for standards and strategic datasets.

Transform complex information into structured, reliable and AI-ready data assets.

Develop AI/LLM-assisted data processing, semantic ingestion and retrieval capabilities.

Strengthen metadata, data quality, lineage, freshness, observability and reliability.

Develop and operate solutions using Python, Kubernetes, Spark, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch and Microsoft Fabric.

Enable AI, LLM and agentic applications through high-quality data and knowledge services.

Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing while remaining hands-on in solution delivery.



KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE


You have:


Strong hands-on experience in production-grade data and software engineering.

Strong Python skills and experience designing automated data pipelines.

Experience with distributed data processing, data modelling, metadata and data quality.

Experience with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch or comparable data and search technologies.

Cloud-native engineering, Kubernetes and container experience.

Knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring and production operations.

Ability to translate complex or ambiguous requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Strong ownership, collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to guide other engineers while remaining hands-on.




It would be nice if you also had:


Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric.

Experience with Spark, BigQuery, OLAP or similar data and analytics technologies.

Experience with LLM-assisted data processing, embeddings, vector search or semantic retrieval.

Knowledge of knowledge graphs, linked data or semantic-data architectures.

Experience with Power BI, Apache Superset or similar visualization tools.

Familiarity with 3GPP, O-RAN, Wi-Fi, MPEG, JVET or ITU-R data.

Experience with research, standardization, intellectual property or patenting-related data and use cases.

Lead Wi‑Fi research and standardization efforts by defining a research agenda, drafting contributions, and presenting in IEEE 802.11 and Wi‑Fi Alliance.

This role sits in Nokia's Global Privacy, Data and Cyber Regulatory Office as the primary legal interface for EU/UK privacy, cybersecurity and AI regulatory matters and is part of an AI-first legal team.

You will provide expert legal advice on GDPR/UK GDPR, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, the EU Data Act and the EU AI Act, lead Nokia's legal engagement on the Cyber Resilience Act, and own supplier security documentation and privacy/security contractual provisions.

The role requires a qualified lawyer admitted in at least one EU member state or in England and Wales with a minimum of 10 years' post-qualification experience and demonstrable hands-on knowledge of GDPR, cybersecurity regulation and supervisory authority engagement.

You will conduct DPIAs, lead privacy and cyber incident response and regulatory notifications, use AI tools to scale legal workflows, manage external counsel, and build collaborative relationships across engineering, security, procurement and business teams.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



As part of Nokia's Legal job family, this role sits within the Global Privacy, Data and Cyber Regulatory Office (GPDCRO) — Nokia's centre of excellence for data protection, cybersecurity regulation, and emerging data-related law — reporting to the Head of Privacy and Data Trust. It applies deep specialist expertise across data protection, cybersecurity law, AI governance, commercial contracting, and incident response, acting as the primary legal interface between Nokia's European and UK business operations and the rapidly evolving regulatory landscape.

This is an AI-first legal team. We actively build and use AI-assisted workflows — from agentic legal research to automated regulatory horizon scanning — and expect everyone in the team to engage seriously with what AI can do for legal work. The role works alongside counterparts covering the Americas, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific, with genuine opportunity to collaborate on cross-jurisdictional matters. If you are excited by building the legal function of the future rather than maintaining the legal function of the past, you will fit in here.


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN


Provide expert legal advice across the full EU and UK data protection and cybersecurity regulatory landscape, including GDPR, UK GDPR/DPA 2018, NIS2, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, the EU Data Act, the EU AI Act, and applicable national implementing legislation.

Lead Nokia's legal engagement with the Cyber Resilience Act, including the legal track for open-source software obligations in network products, conformity requirements, and evolving delegated acts.

Own the legal workstream for Nokia's supplier security documentation, including the modular security appendix applied across Nokia's global supply chain.

Advise on privacy and cybersecurity requirements in customer contracts and procurement processes, including data processing agreements, security appendices, and data localisation requirements.

Conduct horizon scanning across EU and UK regulatory developments, triaging legal risk and preparing clear, actionable briefings for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

Lead legal review of Nokia's use of regulated data types — telecom subscriber data, network data, employee data — advising on permissible use cases, anonymisation standards, and access controls.

Conduct and review Data Protection Impact Assessments for high-risk processing activities, including AI-driven use cases and network analytics.

Actively identify opportunities to move Nokia's compliance posture from paper-based to demonstrable — working with engineering, security, and data teams to embed legal requirements as technical controls into systems and workflows. In practice: data minimisation enforced at the API layer, purpose restrictions implemented as access controls, anonymisation validated against re-identification risk rather than assumed.

Play a central role in cyber and privacy incident response — making timely, legally sound decisions on notification obligations under NIS2, GDPR Articles 33/34, and applicable national legislation, and maintaining Nokia's incident response legal playbook.

Provide privacy, data use, and cyber law input into Nokia's AI governance programme and internal AI deployment — ensuring legal requirements are embedded at design stage.

Deliver training and legal briefings to internal teams, leveraging AI tools to create scalable, repeatable guidance — building legal capability across the organisation rather than creating dependency on the legal team.

Manage external legal counsel on EU and UK matters, with accountability for scope, quality, and cost.

Build trusted, collaborative relationships across Information Security, Product Security, Procurement, Business Groups, CTO, and Human Resources — acting as a proactive legal partner and handling matters end-to-end, enabling the Head of Privacy and Data Trust to focus on global strategy and executive engagement.



KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE


Skills and experience

We recognise that experience rarely maps perfectly to a job description. If this role excites you and your experience covers the substantial majority of the requirements below, we encourage you to put yourself forward.

Must Have


Qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in at least one EU member state or in England and Wales, with a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in data protection, cybersecurity law, or a closely related technology law specialism.

Hands-on knowledge of GDPR and UK GDPR, with a track record of advising complex, multinational organisations on compliance programme design, incident response, and supervisory authority engagement.

Substantive familiarity with EU cybersecurity regulation — particularly the Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, and the EU AI Act — and the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for technical and commercial audiences.

Genuine intellectual curiosity about technology: comfortable engaging with engineers and architects, asking the right questions, and identifying legal risk in technically complex environments. You do not need to be a software engineer — you do need to be genuinely interested in how the technology works.

A working familiarity with AI tools — including large language models and agentic workflows — and a willingness to use them to enhance legal research, drafting, and horizon scanning. We are building a team that embraces AI to amplify legal capability and deliver better outcomes.

Experience advising on privacy, security, and AI clauses in commercial contracts, supplier agreements, and customer-facing data processing agreements.

Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how legal and regulatory work contributes to business performance and customer relationships — able to frame legal risk in terms that resonate with commercial and operational audiences, not just legal ones.

Ability to manage a varied, high-volume portfolio independently, prioritising by materiality and delivering concise, business-ready advice.

Experience of incident and crisis response from a legal perspective, including regulatory notification obligations under NIS2 and GDPR, and privilege management under time pressure.

Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to make complex legal analysis genuinely useful for non-legal audiences, and the interpersonal skills to build trusted relationships and influence without authority in a large, matrixed organisation.




Nice to Have


Experience in telecommunications, technology, or critical infrastructure, where data sovereignty, network data, and cybersecurity regulatory obligations intersect.

Experience designing modular contractual frameworks — such as security appendices or DPA templates — applied across a global supply chain.

Experience with privacy management platforms such as OneTrust.

A relevant qualification — CIPP/E, CIPM, or equivalent — is desirable but not essential; we are more interested in demonstrated capability than credentials.

External visibility or a professional network in EU/UK data protection or cybersecurity law.

You will embed AI‑first principles and collaborate across physical layer, RF, regulatory and product teams while benefiting from flexible hybrid working, parental leave and professional development programs at Nokia.

Research & Innovation is seeking ambitious and highly engaged radio protocol layer Radio Research and Standardization Specialists to join our Protocol Layer Standardization & Research team. In this role, you will drive 6G research and standardization, lead innovation for 6G radio interface, radio protocols and measurements and requirements for radio resource managements, and help shape the future of mobile communications—ensuring Nokia’s continued leadership in wireless research.

We are looking for experts with diverse backgrounds and levels of experience; therefore, the Job Grade (JG) will be determined and aligned based on the selected candidate’s qualifications, expertise, and overall experience.

Lead end-to-end 6G radio protocol or UE RRM research and standardization on at least one of the following areas;


Control plane aspects including RRC protocol architecture and design, which integrates AI enablers and future proof AI framework for, RRC states​, Spectrum Aggregation, Mobility, flexible UL/DL​, device type, UE capability design etc o

User plane design for MAC, PDCP, SDAP, RLC, QoS and service and AI awareness

Interactions between MAC and physical layer such as L2 procedures for HARQ, scheduling, MIMO, and AI enablers etcf the RRC

UE measurements and requirements for radio resource management

Evaluation of performance of proposed innovations including link-level or system-level simulations



Act as Nokia researcher on one of the above-mentioned areas responsible for technical contributions, concept development, simulations, and aligning standardization research with Nokia's 6G priorities.


or


Act as Nokia’s delegate representative to 3GPP RAN2 or RAN4 (UE RRM), taking ownership of technical contributions, agenda shaping, consensus building, and alignment of standardization outcomes with Nokia’s 6G research and business priorities

Develop pioneering 6G intellectual property on radio radio protocol area

Embed AI‑first principles into 6G standards research

Represent and champion Nokia’s technical leadership in 3GPP and external research forums, advocating next‑generation radio protocol design and architectures.



Shape Nokia’s 6G technology and standards strategy, contributing to long‑term research roadmaps for radio protocols on user plane, control plane or UE radio resource management area aligned with business and ecosystem priorities.

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




The role reports to the VP, Corporate Communication and serves as senior communications partner to the CFO, Chief Legal Officer and Chief Government and Geopolitical Relations Officer.

You will develop and execute integrated communications strategies that align with Nokia's corporate narrative, business priorities and reputation objectives.

You will translate complex financial, legal, regulatory and geopolitical developments into clear narratives and prepare executives for media, analyst and stakeholder engagements.

The role requires extensive senior communications experience, strong judgment, outstanding writing skills, high discretion, stakeholder management and a proactive approach to AI.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



Finance, Legal, Government and Geopolitical Relations leads communications strategy and execution across a portfolio of critical corporate functions that shape Nokia's business performance, governance, stakeholder engagement and long-term strategic positioning.

The role operates within Nokia's functional GMC model, reporting to the VP, Corporate Communication. The individual will serve as the senior communications partner to three members of Nokia's Group Leadership Team, supporting the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Legal Officer and Chief Government and Geopolitical Relations Officer. The role is responsible for developing and executing integrated communications strategies that advance the priorities of these functions while ensuring alignment with Nokia's corporate narrative, business strategy and reputation objectives.

Working across multiple executive stakeholders, the role orchestrates resources from internal communications, media relations, analyst relations, digital channels and agency partners to deliver high-impact communications programmes and executive engagement activities. Success requires exceptional stakeholder management, sound judgement and the ability to balance competing priorities across a diverse portfolio of strategic issues.

The role serves as a trusted adviser to senior executives, translating complex financial, legal, regulatory, technology and geopolitical developments into clear and compelling narratives for employees, customers, investors, policymakers, media and other stakeholders.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

Executive and Strategic Communications

• Serve as the primary communications adviser to the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Legal Officer and Chief Government and Geopolitical Relations Officer.

• Develop and own integrated communications strategies aligned with Nokia's business priorities, corporate narrative and reputation objectives.

• Translate complex business, financial, legal, regulatory, technology and geopolitical developments into compelling narratives for internal and external audiences.

• Develop executive content including internal posts, speeches, videos, presentations, leadership communications and strategic messaging materials.

• Prepare senior executives for high-profile engagements, including media interviews, analyst briefings, policy forums, industry events and internal leadership communications.

• Ensure consistency and alignment across executive narratives, reinforcing Nokia's strategy, values and long-term business ambitions.

Strategic Business and Stakeholder Communications

• Develop and execute integrated communications strategies that support key corporate functions and advance business priorities, reputation and strategic objectives.

• Support executive engagement with employees, customers, investors, policymakers, regulators and other key stakeholder groups.

• Partner closely with leadership teams to communicate strategic priorities, business performance, transformation initiatives, governance matters and policy positions.

• Develop communications approaches that strengthen stakeholder trust, reinforce the corporate narrative and support long-term business success.

• Support thought leadership, executive visibility and stakeholder engagement programmes across priority topics and markets.

• Monitor developments across business, regulatory and geopolitical environments, identifying communications opportunities and considerations that support executive engagement and informed decision-making.

Resource Orchestration and Ways of Working

• Operate within the functional GMC model, drawing on resources across media relations, internal communications, digital channels, analyst relations and agency partners.

• Set clear priorities, briefs and quality standards for communications activities across multiple functions and stakeholder groups.

• Build strong relationships across GMC and partner functions to ensure communications are coordinated, consistent and aligned with business objectives.

• Be willing to operate hands-on, writing, briefing, preparing and executing communications directly where required.

KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE


• Extensive senior communications experience within a global organisation.

• Proven ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies spanning executive, internal and external communications.

• Strong executive communications and advisory skills, with experience supporting senior leaders in high-profile and strategically important roles.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex business, financial, legal, regulatory or policy issues into clear and compelling communications.

• Strong strategic thinking and sound judgement.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and navigating sensitive business topics.

• A confident and proactive approach to AI.

• High personal discretion, sound judgement and the ability to work effectively under pressure and at pace.

You will contribute to building Nokia’s 6G standard-essential patent portfolio by drafting and prosecuting 3GPP-related patent applications inhouse and with external counsel.

The role includes developing and supporting the SEP portfolio, evaluating filed applications and claim charts, and planning global prosecution strategies to maximize value.

Candidates must have a master’s degree in electrical engineering, telecommunications, computer science, physics or mathematics and be a qualified European patent attorney or US patent attorney/agent (or have passed multiple EQE papers), with experience in telecom and computer-implemented patent prosecution.

You will work in a collaborative team with inventors and external partners and will benefit from hybrid working, development programs and other employee support.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



Nokia Technology Standards is both 3GPP research and patent licensing entity, building on Nokia’s continued innovation and decades of R&D leadership in technologies deployed in virtually all connected devices used today. Come join us and make an impact!

We have an exciting opportunity for a patent professional to join a world-class Patenting team of inhouse patent attorneys. The team works mainly on drafting and prosecuting patent applications essential to 3GPP standards, thus creating assets for licensing. You will work not only with skilled colleagues but also with an extensive network of external associates.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN


You will make a direct impact on building the Nokia patent portfolio for the 6th generation cellular communication system standardized within the 3GPP.

You will be responsible for standard essential patent (SEP) portfolio development and support primarily in the following areas:


Drafting standard-related patent applications inhouse and with external patent attorneys

Prosecuting globally the patent applications inhouse and with external patent attorneys

Evaluating filed patent applications on a regular basis, including reviewing claim charts and evaluating patent validity in order to plan and execute the best prosecution strategies for your cases to bring out the best value



All above is based on collaborating closely with the inventor community

You will work in a team of highly-competent patent attorneys that will provide you with their support and advice, whenever needed. And also ask you for your advice.

Besides your core duties, you will also get opportunity to contribute in various development and pilot activities where new work practices and tools are probed.


KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunication, Computer Science, Physics/Mathematics, or equivalent field

Experience with telecom and computer-implemented patent applications and prosecution thereof

Qualified European Patent attorney or passed multiple papers of European Qualifying Examination or US Patent Attorney/Agent.


It would be nice if you also had:


Experience with 3GPP related technologies and standards, or with other standard-essential patents in the field of telecommunication

Open and fearless attitude towards innovating and testing new practices

Great skills at building relationships with internal and external stakeholders

Strong business judgment, analytical acumen, and negotiation skills

Time management skills

Communication skills, both written and oral

Mentality of a collaborative team player

Ability to motivate and inspire others

Solution-oriented attitude

Mindset for constant development

The role requires 7+ years of hands-on legal experience in technology, patent and IP licensing and transactions, and a Master’s degree in law.

We are looking for a senior legal professional to join the Technology Standards Legal & Compliance team within MI L&C. In this role, you will lead and coordinate the legal work supporting the protection and successful monetization of Nokia’s intellectual property globally through patent transactions, licensing and other strategic monetization initiatives. You will work closely with key stakeholders in the TS business, including its Partnering, Licensing, Strategy and Commercial Management Teams, ensuring the execution of TS strategic priorities and adherence to best practices within Nokia. You, together with the team, will contribute to strategic decision-making and enhance operational efficiency in your area of responsibility in support of the success of Technology Standards. This is a unique opportunity to lead transactional work in a high-impact, dynamic and cross-functional team within MI L&C.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN


Provide high-impact, specialist legal advice and hands-on support for complex IP transactions, M&A, licensing arrangements and other strategic initiatives.

Provide strategic legal advice and business partner support to TS business, including its Partnering, Licensing, Strategy, Patenting and Commercial Management Teams.

Develop and maintain policies, processes and governance relevant to TS operations, mitigating risks and improving operational efficiency of Nokia’s business.

Deliver training and guidance to internal stakeholders in your areas of responsibility.

7+ years of professional hands-on legal working experience in the areas of technology, patent and IP licensing and transactions, cross-border transactions, M&A, governance and compliance. Excellent legal knowledge in the area of intellectual property law, with an ability to provide practical and actionable legal advice in the area of responsibility.

Readiness and aptitude for seeking viable compromise solutions that adhere to Nokia’s best practices and policies in patent licensing and ensure the long-term sustainability of Nokia’s patent licensing business.

Master’s degree in law.

The role will drive conceptualization of new security technologies and foster collaboration with internal teams, the patenting organization, Bell Labs and the external security ecosystem.

The position requires deep technical expertise in 5G/6G security and 3GPP technologies, proven standardization leadership, strong communication skills and an MSc.

Nokia maintains broad annual base salary ranges for its roles and provides benefits including health and dental coverage, retirement savings, disability and an employee stock purchase plan.

Technology Standards Research & Innovation (TS R&I) in Nokia Mobile Infrastructure (MI) business segment is responsible for research and standardization activities related to 5G and 6G cellular networks and collaboration with internal and external experts to advance the technology landscape as well as to protect Intellectual Property.

Represent Nokia’s interests, views & preferences in external forums (e.g. standard organizations and particularly 3GPP SA3, associations, public bodies) and ecosystems


Drive conceptualization of new technology areas in the security research and standardization team in collaboration with Nokia patenting organization and business segments

Build strong relationships with customers, industry players, and governmental leaders



Foster collaboration and innovation with the external security ecosystem


Collaborate with Nokia Business Segments as well as Nokia Bell Labs experts to align with product roadmaps, research visions and strategies as well as latest research finding.

Standardization experience: contributions as a delegate in security-related SDOs

You will support and enhance maintenance processes and systems for agreement customers, with Maximo as the backbone integrated to SAP, CRM and Field Service tools.

Main tasks include analysing and troubleshooting integrations, specifying and testing enhancements, participating as a subject-matter expert in development projects, and creating training and process documentation.

The candidate must have minimum three years' experience in maintenance planning or system administration in asset-intensive industries, professional Maximo or comparable CMMS experience, integration experience between CMMS/ERP/CRM/Field Service, and a relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



Maintenance processes and tools Expert



We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?



We are looking for a Maintenance Processes and Tools Expert with main responsibility to support and enhance both processes and systems for maintenance in our agreements business. For our agreement customers, Maximo is the backbone of maintenance management — integrated with SAP, CRM, Field Service tools, and multiple data flows. Major company-wide initiatives (Service Flow, One Data, as-maintained digital twin) are reshaping the landscape around us, and we need someone who ensures our ecosystem runs well today and is ready for what's coming.

The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland but will also consider Turku or Helsinki. We offer a possibility to hybrid remote work.



Your role and responsibilities



As a Maintenance Processes and Tools Expert your work will include engaging challenges related to system enhancements, integrations, and issue resolution within the maintenance management ecosystem. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests. You'll be working as part of our highly skilled and development-driven team with diverse expertise.


Maintain deep knowledge of maintenance planning processes for agreement customers, actively gather and challenge user needs and translate them into system improvements and lifecycle decisions.

Analyse, troubleshoot, and enhance integrations between Maximo and connected systems (SAP, CRM, Field Service tools).

Assess how broader Wärtsilä initiatives impact the agreements maintenance ecosystem — proactively identify what needs to change.

Participate in development projects as a subject matter expert.

Test and validate new features, enhancements, and bug fixes by utilizing own expertise and the key user forum experts.

Provide training on newly developed features to key users and maintenance planners.

Create process documentation and training material, including online courses.

Contribute ideas for developing visualizations, dashboards, and configuring systems.




Requirements for the position:




Minimum 3 years in maintenance planning, maintenance operations or maintenance system administration in heavy-duty, energy, marine, or comparable asset-intensive industry.

Has used or administered Maximo (or comparable CMMS such as SAP PM, IFS, or Infor) in a professional role.

Has worked directly with system integrations between at least two of: CMMS, ERP, CRM, or Field Service tools — involving troubleshooting, specifying, testing, or development.

Has created process documentation, training materials, or system specifications professionally.

Professional proficiency in English, written and verbal.

Bachelor's degree in engineering, IT, or business information systems — or equivalent demonstrated through work experience.




To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:




Systems thinking — ability to see dependencies, consequences, and ripple effects across interconnected systems and organizations. This is the single most important trait for success in this role.

Structured problem-solving in complex environments.

Facilitation and stakeholder-management skills — able to run workshops, build consensus, and turn diverse input into clear requirements.

Curiosity toward adjacent domains beyond one's own scope.

Experience with SAP (PM/CS modules or integration touchpoints).

Agile methodology (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).

Understanding of digital twin concepts or master data management.

Experience with integration middleware, APIs, or data mapping tools.

Experience creating e-learning content.




Why you and us?

You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting an inclusive work community.

Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.

You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Wärtsilä is hiring an Engine Automation Commissioning Engineer (Commissioning Engineer, Senior or Chief) to perform hands-on commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of Wärtsilä engine automation systems (UNIC) at new‑build energy sites.

The permanent position is based in Vaasa, Turku, or Helsinki, Finland, and requires approximately 250 days per year working on site abroad.

Candidates must hold a B.Sc. in Automation or a related field and have at least five years of automation commissioning experience with strong combustion engine process knowledge and practical fault‑finding skills.

Applications must be submitted through Wärtsilä’s career portal before the last application date of 04/11/2026.

Bring engines to life on new-build energy sites around the world. Wärtsilä Energy Business is looking for a Chief Commissioning Engineer, Engine Automation to join our Construction and Commissioning Services team. This is a hands-on opportunity to combine engine process knowledge, Engine Control System expertise, and practical troubleshooting to deliver reliable engine operation for our customers. We welcome applicants at different seniority levels: the role can be offered as Commissioning Engineer, Senior Commissioning Engineer or Chief Commissioning Engineer.

This is a permanent position based in Vaasa, Turku or Helsinki, Finland. The role focuses on engine automation commissioning at new-build energy sites and involves extensive international assignments, with approximately 250 days per year spent working on-site abroad. If you enjoy practical site work, international teamwork, and seeing the results of your expertise in operation, this role offers an opportunity to make a direct impact.

What will you be doing?

In this role, you will turn engine automation expertise into safe, reliable operation at Wärtsilä’s new-build energy sites. Your focus will be the commissioning, testing and troubleshooting of Wärtsilä engine automation systems, particularly UNIC, together with the associated engine and plant auxiliaries. Working with global project teams, subcontractors and customers, you will resolve technical issues and help deliver high-quality commissioning results.

Your responsibilities for the role include, but are not limited to:


Carrying out hands-on commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of Wärtsilä engine automation systems (UNIC) at new-build energy sites, with a focus on safe and reliable engine operation



Checking and adjusting engine and plant auxiliary systems, applying engine process knowledge to troubleshoot issues and optimising operation in collaboration with the site team



Documenting commissioning activities, test results, and technical findings in clear internal and customer reports in line with Wärtsilä standards


Technical skills and qualifications:


B.Sc. or similar in Automation Engineering or a related field



At least five years of relevant automation commissioning experience, with hands-on capability in testing and troubleshooting engine automation systems



Strong understanding of combustion engine processes and the tuning and adjustments needed to achieve reliable engine operation



Proven practical expertise with engine automation systems, including commissioning, testing, and fault finding; UNIC system knowledge is seen as an advantage



Familiarity with Wärtsilä four-stroke engines and how their operation is controlled through UNIC



Understanding of mechanical and fluid processes and their interaction with engine automation; broader knowledge of Wärtsilä engine types and auxiliary systems is an advantage



Excellent written and spoken English language skills


The following will enable you to succeed in this role:


Flexibility and resilience to work abroad for extended periods



A systematic, hands-on approach to diagnosing faults and resolving engine automation and process-related issues



Positive mindset, adaptability, and strong team spirit



Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills, with confidence in collaborating effectively with subcontractors, customers, and internal stakeholders


Why you and us?



We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each other’s growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more.
