ads.description_raw:
Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




The IT Solution Manager will join Neste's Sales and Supply Chain IT team in Espoo to focus on SAP Supply Chain and logistics for the Renewable Products business area.

You will lead delivery of logistics improvement projects and small enhancements, acting as project manager or stream lead while ensuring service quality and cost-efficient support.

Required qualifications include strong SAP supply chain and pricing expertise with experience in solution design, configuration and integrations, project work in multi-site and multi-vendor environments, excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, and a relevant university degree.

Applications must be submitted through Neste's recruitment system by 31 October 2026.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel.

We are looking for you,




IT Solution Manager, SAP Supply Chain and Logistics



to our Sales and Supply Chain IT Team in Espoo.

You will focus on the supply chain in our Renewable Products business area. In this job you will work closely with other IT colleagues, business stakeholders, process development and with IT vendors, globally.


In our team, we are responsible to ensure Neste has the right supply chain solutions for effective business usage. Together with you and your expertise, we can make an impact today and keep our promises for tomorrow.



More about the job

Your role in our team



This role is a combination of hands-on and stakeholder management responsibilities. On the development side you will be leading the delivery of logistics improvement projects and small enhancements. This may include acting as project manager for smaller initiatives or stream lead in larger projects. On the operating side you will be ensuring the service quality and cost efficiency of our support services. Additionally, you will provide functional and architectural direction and guidance regarding your area of responsibility.



Keys to success in this role


We expect you to have profound knowledge in SAP Supply Chain and pricing solutions:




Experience in solution design, system development, testing and deployments




Experience in SAP configurations and integrations




Experience in project work in multi-site and multi-vendor environment




Target oriented, pro-active and systematic way of working

Good communication and cooperation skills

Continuously eager to learn and adaptable to evolving circumstances

Proficient in written and oral English, with strong presentation skills

Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to collaborate effectively with various internal and external parties

University level degree in computer science, logistics or other relevant field




We also value


Experience in logistics, terminal and transportation management related IT development

Experience in challenging and international development projects

Understanding of Operations Management

Long term commitment



Let’s get you started

We look forward to receiving your CV and application (with a salary request) by 31st of October, 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Mika Rytkönen, IT Solutions Team Manager, p. +358 50 458 0821 on Tuesday October 20 between 11-12am or Tuesday October 27 between 3-4pm.

Due to security and confidentiality, please submit your application through our recruitment system. Applications sent via email will not be considered.



We will do our best to contact you within 2 weeks after the application time has ended. The recruitment process will include interviews and a possible aptitude assessment. Depending on the requirements of the position, the process may include a security clearance (with a drug test) and a potential statutory health examination based on work-related exposures.





Neste in brief



Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. Neste’s strategy focuses on growth in renewable fuels. The company’s renewables production capacity is expected to reach 6.8 million tons annually in 2027. Neste also produces high-quality oil products at its Porvoo refinery in Finland. The company has a network of nearly 1,000 fuel stations with expanding service offering, such as EV charging, in Finland and in the Baltics. Neste is included in many international indices for its sustainability performance. In 2025, Neste's revenue stood at EUR 19.0 billion. Read more: neste.com

Olisitko sinä uusi työkaverimme määräaikaiseen tehtävään ajalle 1.3.2027–31.8.2027? Hae mukaan tiimiimme!



Tehtävästä

Tässä tehtävässä osallistut Loviisan voimalaitoksen vedenkäsittelyyn aina raakaveden otosta prosessi- ja talousveden valmistukseen sekä lauhteiden puhdistukseen ja jätevesien käsittelyyn. Työhön sisältyy sekä kenttäoperointeja että prosessin valvontaa paikallisvalvomoista. Työ on päivätyötä ja sitä tehdään arkipäivinä.



Mitä odotamme sinulta


Olet iältäsi vähintään 18-vuotias.

Prosessiteollisuuden perustutkinto tai muu soveltuva ammatillinen koulutus on eduksi.

Arvostamme kerrytettyä työkokemusta voimalaitokselta, vedenkäsittelystä tai prosessiteollisuudesta.

Turvallisen työskentelyn varmistamiseksi ja ohjeiston ymmärtämiseksi edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista osaamista.



Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteisuutta, halua kehittää osaamistasi sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja eri ihmisten ja ryhmien kanssa työskentelyyn.





Tarjoamme sinulle

Me Fortumilla uskomme parempaan tulevaisuuteen ja haluamme olla mukana sen muovaamisessa. Meiltä löydät turvallisen työympäristön, jossa pääset kasvamaan ja kehittymään osana asiantuntevaa yhteisöämme. Tarjoamme sinulle kattavat työsuhde-edut. Olemme sitoutuneet rakentamaan tiimejä, joissa jokainen voi tuntea kuuluvansa joukkoon, ja joissa kaikkia kohdellaan tasavertaisesti.

Lue lisää eduistamme sekä työskentelystä Fortumilla täältä: Työskentely Fortumilla



Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta mahdollisuudelta, lähetä CV:si rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 31.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Harri Lehtinen, puh. 010 455 3506. Harri on tavoitettavissa arkisin ajalla 12.10.-23.10.2026.

Tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä edellytämme hyväksyttyä turvallisuusselvitystä ja terveystarkastusta, joka sisältää myös huumausainetestauksen.

Loviisan voimalaitos on savuton työpaikka.



Me olemme Fortum

Fortum on pohjoismainen energiayhtiö. Tuotamme ja toimitamme asiakkaillemme ja pohjoismaiselle energiajärjestelmälle energiaa luotettavasti sekä autamme teollisuutta vähentämään hiilidioksidipäästöjään ja kasvamaan. Ydintoimintamme koostuu tehokkaasta ja ensiluokkaisesta vähähiilisestä sähköntuotannosta, asiakasliiketoiminnoista sekä kaukolämmöstä ja -kylmästä. Jo 99 prosenttia Fortumin sähköntuotannosta perustuu uusiutuviin energianlähteisiin ja ydinvoimaan, ja ominaispäästömme ovat Euroopan alhaisimpia. Kunnianhimoiset ja tieteeseen perustuvat, SBTi:n hyväksymät päästövähennystavoitteemme ohjaavat meitä, kun kuljemme kohti nettonollapäästöjä vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Tarjoamme noin 4 500 työntekijällemme turvallisen ja inspiroivan työympäristön. Fortum Oyj:n osake noteerataan Nasdaq Helsingissä. fortum.fi



Meillä Fortumissa työskentelee noin 750 ydinvoima-alan ammattilaista, joista noin 570 Loviisan voimalaitoksella. Suomen ensimmäinen ydinvoimalaitos Loviisassa on tuottanut turvallisesti sähköä jo yli 45 vuoden ajan, kattaen noin 10 % koko maan sähköntuotannosta. Toimintamme ydin perustuu osaavaan ja sitoutuneeseen henkilöstöön sekä vahvaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin. Pyrimme varmistamaan turvallisen ja luotettavan sähköntuotannon myös tulevaisuudessa, panostamalla organisaation jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen. Arvostamme henkilöstömme monipuolista osaamista ja tuemme heidän jatkuvaa kehittymistään kohti yhteistä onnistumista.

Are you an experienced IT Project Manager with an interest in mergers and acquisitions?



In this role, you will spend most of your time leading IT projects related to Mergers, Acquisitions and Divestments (MAD). During periods when there are fewer ongoing MAD projects, you will lead other IT projects within Fortum.



About the role



As Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing IT MAD projects and other IT projects, together with the project owners, project stakeholders and project team.



You will act as the operational lead for the project and oversee its day-to-day activities. You will be responsible for ensuring that the agreed project scope is delivered according to timeline, budget and quality expectations.



The primary type of projects you will lead are IT MAD projects. Specific aspects of leading IT MAD projects include:


Managing and supporting IT (V)DD activities, data gathering, planning (e.g. Day 1 readiness, carve-outs, integrations and project plans), TSA development and project execution.

Managing and supporting IT carve-outs and integrations.

Supporting the use of common IT MAD methodologies, tools and templates across projects.

Contributing to the further development of IT MAD-related processes, methods and tools.

Reporting projects to the IT M&A Lead.

Helping to manage IT MAD stakeholder groups.




As a Project Manager for any project, you take responsibility to, for example:


Creating project plans in cooperation with relevant parties and ensuring agreed deliverables and project outcomes are completed.

Following up on the business case, value creation and KPIs.

Ensuring Fortum's project model requirements are met and applying the IT MAD project playbook in relevant projects, while contributing to its further development when needed. Ensuring the projects are planned with all needed actions as required by the Fortum general operative models and instructions.

Monitoring project finances, risks and dependencies, and providing project reporting.

Ensuring effective communication and information sharing, and resolving issues and roadblocks.




About you

You are highly structured and excel at translating complex situations into clear plans, milestones and actions. You proactively identify risks, dependencies and decision points and ensure project remains on track.

You have a strong delivery mindset and proven ability to lead projects from planning through execution and completion. You follow up on commitments, remove roadblocks and ensure actions are completed.

You communicate clearly and effectively, build trust with a wide range of stakeholders and are comfortable engaging with both subject matter experts and senior decision makers.



To be successful in this role, we believe you have:


3-5 years’ experience in project management, particularly within IT MAD projects, as well as broader IT projects.

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration or another relevant field.

Project Management Certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, Prince).

Fluent written and spoken English.

Good leadership and communication skills.

Ability to  work a few days a week from Fortum’s office in Espoo, Finland.




We offer you



Fortum is in an exciting phase, where a lot of changes are happening. If you are curious and interested to learn new things, you’ll find a company where things keep moving forward and change and improvement are always welcomed. Through leading IT MAD projects and other IT projects, you are actively part of creating that journey and contributing to the success of these projects driving major changes for our company.



You will join a team of skilled and talented IT Project Managers. In your IT MAD projects, you will collaborate with a broad network of professionals and receive support and guidance from Fortum's IT M&A Lead.

Help to Build WISA's Modern IT Operations





Location: Finland | Hybrid working

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Join us at an exciting time



We have been known for high-quality Plywood products for decades. Now, as UPM Plywood proceeds its transitions into an independent company, WISA Group, we are also building IT supplier ecosystem and IT Service Management practices that support our future business. We are investing in many IT technologies and services meaning a wide range of suppliers to be involved. We are building IT Service Management platform to support service operations driven by IT suppliers  - This is to be developed further to have reliable fit-for-purpose foundation for our operations. To support this journey, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Service Manager to join our team.

What makes this role interesting?



This is not a role where you will simply monitor service reports and follow established processes.

We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of end-to-end IT services, strengthening supplier collaboration and working closely with business stakeholders and IT partners to ensure reliable service delivery.

As we build our future IT operating model, you will have the opportunity to shape service management practices, governance and performance measures while staying close to daily operations and improvement initiatives.

You will work across our IT supplier ecosystem and service portfolio, helping ensure business continuity, strong service performance, cost efficiency and continuous improvement for both office and manufacturing operations.

What you'll be doing

In this role, you will:

·         Develop IT service management practices and external support & maintenance set-up in close co-operation with other stakeholders

·         Lead external service delivery and turn supplier agreements into reliable, business-critical services

·         Ensure services consistently meet business-driven SLAs and deliver the reliability our operations depend on

·         Establish and lead effective IT service governance forums that drive clear decisions and action

·         Collaborate across the IT ecosystem to make services more efficient, proactive and business-focused

·         Champion continuous service improvement across IT service delivery, turning insights into measurable results

·         Own external costs related IT service cost centers budgeting, forecasting and cost performance, balancing financial discipline with business value

·         Coordinate the evolution of WISA Plywood’s IT Service Management platform to enable smoother and smarter service operations





What we're looking for

What matters is that you have strong service mindset, sense of ownership and can work effectively with different stakeholders.

We expect you to have:

·         Good supplier management skills and knowledge of IT processes (ITIL)

·         Experience in accounting, budgeting and cost allocation

·         IT Service Management tool (e.g. ServiceNow) experience and interest in coordinating this area development further

·         Innovative and forward-looking mindset

·         Excellent communication, co-operation and change management skills – project management skills considered as advantage

·         You are cost and value consciousness

·         You are proactive and accountable

It would be an advantage if you also have knowledge about manufacturing environments, SAP, Salesforce and data platforms.





Why join?



This is a unique opportunity to join a company at an important stage of its journey.

You'll have the chance to:

·         Help to build and develop IT supplier ecosystem of a newly independent company

·         Shape IT service management, supplier governance and performance

·         Drive reliable, cost-effective services for business continuity and growth

·         Collaborate with experienced colleagues and trusted partners

·         Develop your skills in a supportive and international environment

·         Enjoy flexible working arrangements and competitive benefits





Join us and help build our future IT environment.

We are now looking for a Specialist/Senior Specialist, Payroll Services to join our Payroll team. The position is located in Tampere or Helsinki, Finland, or in Krakow, Poland.

Greetings from your future manager

“As a Payroll Specialist, you will join our international community of payroll professionals, where we work together to deliver accurate, compliant and reliable payroll services. Your main focus will be Finland payroll, and you will play a key role in ensuring smooth end-to-end payroll delivery together with our internal teams and external payroll partners. While Finland will be at the heart of your role, you will also be part of our broader Global Payroll organization, giving you the opportunity to collaborate across countries, learn from colleagues and contribute to how we develop payroll globally. If you are passionate about payroll, enjoy taking ownership and want to develop together with us, I hope to hear from you!” – Nina Roos, Director, Global Payroll





What you will do


Contribute to the ongoing payroll and time management transformation project in Finland, including transition activities, process design, way-of-working development, and readiness of the new service model

Support the successful implementation and stabilization of new payroll and time management technologies, ensuring they meet the practical needs of UPM payroll operations

Partner closely with external payroll provider and UPM internal stakeholders to manage data flows (attendances, variable pay, benefits, and master data changes) and monitor service level agreements (SLAs)

Perform pre-payroll and post-payroll reconciliations, audits, and quality checks on reports provided by external vendors to guarantee correct salary disbursements

Ensure that all payroll processes comply with labor laws, tax regulations, and statutory reporting requirements, leveraging the expertise of local providers and advisors

Work closely with Finance, HR, and People Operations to support accounting reconciliations, general ledger postings, year-end closing, and internal/external audits

Serve as an escalation point for complex payroll inquiries regarding pay, tax deductions, benefits or international situations

Participate in continuous improvement, process optimization, and the development of standardized payroll frameworks and digital tools; as the role matures, responsibilities may expand to support payroll operations and development initiatives across European countries






Who you are


You have solid professional experience (3–5+ years for Specialist or 5+ years for Senior Specialist) in managing payroll operations, preferably within international corporate environments or payroll service providers

You have direct knowledge and proven experience handling payroll operations for Finland

You possess strong expertise in payroll administration, collective labour agreement compliance requirements, social security and compliance requirements

You are familiar with HRIS/Payroll technologies (e.g., Workday), Time & Attendance systems and proficient with office tools and case management technologies

You have proven ability to manage relationships with external payroll vendors and coordinate effectively across various internal and external stakeholders

You are organized and capable of managing strict deadlines in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment

You have very good interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative mindset and strong problem-solving capabilities

You are fluent in Finnish and English, both written and spoken

Olet kiinnostunut kehittämään omaa osaamistasi sekä työyhteisön toimintaa. Viestit selkeästi eri tilanteissa niin kasvotusten kuin sähköisissä kanavissa. Hallitset useita rajapintoja ja projekteja samanaikaisesti, ja osaat priorisoida ajankäyttöäsi sekä organisoida työtehtäviäsi tehokkaasti. Arvostamme rohkeutta tuoda näkemyksiäsi esiin rakentavasti sekä kykyä kuunnella muita. Ennen kaikkea olet motivoitunut oppimaan uutta ja kehittämään toimintaa.

Sinulla on soveltuva tekninen tutkinto (esim. AMK/DI) esimerkiksi prosessi-, energia-, kemian- tai kone- ja mekaanisen tekniikan alalta. Ymmärrys sellutehtaan prosesseista, laitekannasta ja projektityöskentelystä luetaan eduksi.

Hallitset erilaisia IT-työkaluja ja sinulla on kokemusta kunnossapito- tai toiminnanohjausjärjestelmien käytöstä. Kokemus SAP-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmästä on etu. Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito on välttämätön, jotta yhteistyö palvelutoimittajien ja kumppaneiden kanssa sujuu tehokkaasti.

Greetings from your future manager

What you will do



In this role, you will help shape how UPM sources, manages and develops critical IT supplier relationships. You will work closely with UPM IT, Businesses, Legal, Finance, Security and supplier partners to create value, manage risk and support UPM’s future business needs.

Our team’s ambition is to excel in spend management, secure competitive commercial terms, create measurable value and manage supplier and contractual risks through strategic sourcing. We also lead, manage and continuously improve end-to-end sourcing processes in close cooperation with UPM stakeholders and suppliers.

As IT Sourcing Director, you will lead a globally relevant sourcing area covering technology, IT services, software, cloud, infrastructure, consulting and other IT-related spend. You will play an important role in strengthening strategic category management, supplier relationship management, commercial governance and future-ready IT sourcing capabilities.

In this role, you will:


Lead the development and implementation of IT category sourcing strategies, sourcing plans and supplier business plans aligned with UPM’s IT strategy, priorities and business needs

Lead, manage and deliver strategic IT sourcing projects, negotiations and supplier selection processes across software, cloud, IT services, infrastructure, cybersecurity, consulting and technology platforms

Drive commercial value through competitive sourcing, demand and spend transparency, total cost optimization, contract management and supplier performance management

Strengthen supplier relationship management for critical and strategic IT suppliers, including governance models, business plans, performance monitoring, escalation paths, risk mitigation and value delivery

Support effective risk management across IT sourcing, including contractual, cybersecurity, compliance, sustainability, continuity and supplier dependency risks

Build and maintain market and supplier insights, including technology trends, supplier landscape developments, AI and automation opportunities, and emerging commercial models

Collaborate with UPM IT, Sourcing & Procurement Operations, Legal, Finance, Security, business stakeholders and suppliers to support efficient end-to-end sourcing processes and compliant ways of working

You have experience in sourcing, procurement, supplier management, commercial negotiations or a related area, ideally within an international environment

You bring knowledge of IT services, software, cloud technologies, technology platforms or supplier ecosystems, and you have an interest in emerging technologies, AI, automation and future sourcing approaches

You are confident in developing sourcing strategies, leading negotiations, managing supplier relationships and creating measurable business value

You build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively across functions, cultures and organizational levels

You can balance opportunities and risks, simplify complex topics and bring people together around shared objectives

You communicate clearly and effectively in English and are comfortable engaging with stakeholders across different levels of the organization

You lead with integrity, transparency and an Aiming Higher mindset, and you are motivated to identify opportunities to improve ways of working and deliver better outcomes

ads.description_raw:
We are looking for a Head of Predictive Pharmaceutical Sciences to lead a specialist unit covering predictive modelling, data foundations and laboratory automation within Orion Pharma’s Pharmaceutical Sciences department. The department is responsible for pharmaceutical development across Orion Pharma’s therapeutic portfolio, with a particular focus on product development for synthetic modalities.

In this role, you will define and execute the strategy for predictive pharmaceutical sciences, strengthen the quality and usability of experimental data, and advance fit-for-purpose automation. By embedding mathematical, mechanistic, biopharmaceutical and forecasting models into development decision-making, you will help teams design robust medicinal products and manufacturing processes that support Orion Pharma’s expanding clinical portfolio.

You will lead an expert team of data engineers and scientists in Finland and collaborate closely with laboratory units, the Pharmaceutical Sciences leadership team, and data specialists across Orion Pharma R&D. Through internal collaboration and selected external partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in translating technical innovation into better development decisions and meaningful impact for patients.

Key responsibilities
•    Build and lead a state-of-the-art predictive pharmaceutical sciences capability that combines mechanistic modelling, AI, high-quality experimental data and automation to improve drug product development.
•    Coach a multidisciplinary team, be hands-on, lead by example and strengthen an environment of scientific curiosity, accountability and continuous learning.
•    Combine first-principles and mechanistic modelling, statistical learning and modern AI methods, selecting the approach according to the scientific question, and available evidence.
•    Establish rigorous prospective validation, uncertainty assessment and applicability criteria for predictive methods.
•    Ensure that existing predictive methods are evaluated and used effectively before laboratory experiments and development projects are initiated.
•    Strengthen data collection, structure, quality and accessibility so that experimental data can support modelling, learning and decision-making.
•    Shape automation priorities and investments across in silico and laboratory workflows, based on scientific value, feasibility and business impact.
•    Build trusted, cross-functional relationships and influence senior stakeholders across Pharmaceutical Sciences and Orion Pharma R&D.
•    Initiate and lead value-creating collaborations with start-ups, universities, research institutes and other external partners.
•    Represent Pharmaceutical Sciences internally and Orion Pharma R&D externally through relevant collaborations, scientific networks and conferences.

This Finland-based role reports to the Vice President, Pharmaceutical Sciences, R&D. Relocation support is available.

What you can expect from us?
This is an opportunity to shape a strategically important capability at the intersection of pharmaceutical science, data and automation. You will have the scope to influence how development work is designed and executed, build specialist expertise, and collaborate across Orion Pharma’s international R&D environment. Your work will help turn scientific insight into robust medicines and better outcomes for patients.

At Orion, your work creates true impact and well-being for our customers, patients and society at large. ​ ​Our culture of friendliness, respect, mutual appreciation and diversity creates a safe working environment where you can strive for excellence. We offer a wealth of career paths and development opportunities that support the development of innovative solutions and improving the quality of life.

Please visit our website to find further information about our values and Orion as an employer https://www.orion.fi/en/careers/orion-as-an-employer/ .

What we are looking for
Education and scientific expertise
•    A PhD or equivalent track record in computational science, material sciences, engineering or another relevant quantitative discipline.
•    Experience in pharmaceutical development is valuable, but candidates who have built advanced predictive capabilities in adjacent scientific fields and can translate them into pharmaceutical applications are also encouraged.
•    Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, such as molecular or materials simulation, solid-state prediction, formulation modelling, biopharmaceutics, scientific machine learning, process modelling or autonomous experimentation, together with the ability to connect methods across disciplines.
•    Strong understanding of digital solutions, AI-enabled methods and the data foundations required to apply them responsibly in pharmaceutical development.
•    Understanding of workflow automation across both in silico and laboratory environments.

Leadership and collaboration
•    Demonstrated people leadership experience, with the ability to set direction, empower experts and deliver through others.
•    Experience influencing stakeholders and leading work across scientific, technical and organisational boundaries.
•    Ability to translate complex scientific and technical concepts into clear priorities, decisions and business value.
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in an international working environment.
•    A collaborative, proactive approach and a strong commitment to scientific delivery, innovation and patient impact.

Desirable experience
•    Experience leading change initiatives and engaging teams in new technologies, capabilities and ways of working.
•    Experience working in pharmaceutical development, life sciences or another scientifically complex and regulated environment.
•    A track record of building successful collaborations with external scientific or technology partners.

How to apply

Please submit your application, including your CV, cover letter, and salary request by 25th October 2026. Please note that the applications are reviewed on a rolling basis throughout the application period.

For additional information contact Bert van Veen, Vice President of Pharmaceutical Sciences, tel. +358509664625.Thursday 8th Oct between 10am-12pm CET, Tuesday 13th Oct between 11am-1pm CET and Friday 16th Oct 1pm 2pm CET.

Approved medical examination which also includes drug testing is required prior to the employment. We will also carry out a security clearance prior to the employment for the selected person.

ads.description_raw:
Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




Siemens hakee Lead/Senior System Engineeriä vastaamaan sähköasemien toisio-, suojaus- ja automaatiojärjestelmien teknisestä suunnittelusta ja omistajuudesta.

Työssä teet toisiojärjestelmien uusinta- ja modernisointiprojekteja, laadit kytkentäkaavioita ja suunnitteludokumentaatiota sekä voit toimia projektien Lead Engineerinä ja tukea muiden suunnittelijoiden työtä.

Tehtävään vaaditaan vahva tekninen ymmärrys toisiopiireistä, suojauksesta ja automaatiosta, useamman vuoden kokemus sähkösuunnittelusta, CAD-osaamista (esim. Eplan, Ebase, AutoCAD) sekä sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito.

Tehtävän kotipesä on Espoossa, mutta Lead-tason asiantuntija voi työskennellä muualta Suomesta, ja rekrytoinnin hoitaa Academic Work; valintaprosessiin sisältyy luonteen- ja kognitiivisia testejä.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



Haluatko ottaa teknistä vastuuta Suomen kriittisen sähköverkkoinfrastruktuurin kehittämisestä ja työskennellä vaativien sähköasema-, suojaus- ja automaatioprojektien parissa? Etsimme Siemensin tiimiin kokenutta Lead / Senior System Engineeriä vahvistamaan sähköasemien suunnittelutiimiä. Roolin ytimessä ovat sähköasemien toisiosuunnittelu, suojausjärjestelmät ja automaatio, ja kokeneena osaajana sinulla on mahdollisuus ottaa myös Lead Engineer- / pääsuunnittelijavastuuta merkittävissä asiakasprojekteissa.

Tehtävänkuvaus

Siemens toimittaa asiakkaille ratkaisuja sähkönjakeluun, sähköverkkojen suojaukseen ja automaatioon. Projektit liittyvät muun muassa sähköasemien uudistuksiin, teollisuuteen ja energiainfrastruktuuriin.

Haemme ensisijaisesti kokenutta sähköasemasuunnittelun ammattilaista, joka pystyy ottamaan teknistä omistajuutta projekteista. Olemme kuitenkin kiinnostuneita myös hieman erilaisista taustoista: jos tunnet sähköasemien toisiopiirit, suojauksen ja automaation vahvasti esimerkiksi käytännön asennustyön kautta ja sinulla on lisäksi useamman vuoden kokemus sähkösuunnittelusta, saatat hyvinkin olla etsimämme henkilö.

Työtehtävät

Tässä tehtävässä työsi painottuu erityisesti sähköasemien toisiojärjestelmien uusinta- ja modernisointiprojekteihin. Suojaus ja automaatio muodostavat keskeisen osan päivittäisestä työstä. Työ on pääosin vaativaa teknistä suunnittelua, dokumentointia ja suunnitteluratkaisujen varmistamista, ja kokeneemmalla osaajalla vastuu voi ulottua koko projektin tekniseen suunnitteluun sekä muiden suunnittelijoiden työn tukemiseen ja tarkastamiseen.

Työskentelet kokeneiden suunnittelijoiden ja projektipäälliköiden kanssa, mutta roolissa korostuu kyky työskennellä myös itsenäisesti ja ottaa omistajuutta omista kokonaisuuksista. Työmaakäyntejä voi olla tarpeen mukaan, mutta pääpaino on suunnittelutyössä.


sähköasemien toisiosuunnittelu

teknisten ratkaisujen laadun varmistaminen

Etsimme

Menestyäksesi tehtävässä tarvitset ennen kaikkea vahvan teknisen ymmärryksen siitä, miten sähköaseman toisio-, suojaus- ja automaatiojärjestelmät toimivat kokonaisuutena.

Liityt tiimiin, jossa työskentelee sekä kokeneita sähköasemasuunnittelijoita että uransa aikaisemmassa vaiheessa olevia osaajia. Saat perehdytyksen Siemensin omiin komponentteihin, työkaluihin ja suunnittelukäytäntöihin – kaikkea ei siis tarvitse tuntea ensimmäisenä työpäivänä.

Information

Me Siemensillä rakennamme intohimoisesti parempaa tulevaisuutta meille kaikille. Siemensin toimintaa ohjaavat vastuullisuus, huippuosaaminen ja innovatiivisuus. Meillä pääset rakentamaan kestävää tulevaisuutta. Uskomme, että avoin jahyväksyvä työkulttuuri auttaa meitä menestymään ja osaajia viihtymään. ads.job_title: Senior Mechanical Designer, Safera Oy, Espoo
ads.description_raw:
Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:




You will lead end-to-end mechanical design of electronic devices and optical sensor systems, taking concepts to mass-manufacturable products.

Key tasks include designing small, complex injection-molded plastic components, integrating optics, sensors and LEDs, and performing airflow and thermal simulations.

The role requires advanced knowledge of injection-molded plastic design, strong CFD/airflow simulation skills, self-coordination and professional English.

Safera offers full ownership of the mechanical design department in an agile, startup-like environment and the recruitment is handled by Academic Work with a personality and a cognitive test.



Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.



Are you an experienced Mechanical Designer looking for a role where you can truly take ownership and make an impact? Safera Oy is seeking a Senior Mechanical Designer to take full responsibility for their mechanical design, from initial engineering all the way to manufacturing support. If you thrive in an agile, startup-spirited environment and have a passion for complex, precision-engineered products, this might be your next career move!

About the role

In this role, you will lead and execute mechanical design for innovative electronic devices and optical sensor systems. You will play a central role in transforming concepts into reliable, mass-manufacturable products, working closely with cross-functional teams in a compact, dynamic environment.

You are offered


Full Ownership & Impact: A key role with total responsibility for the mechanical design department, giving you the freedom to shape engineering processes and influence final product outcomes.

Agile & Collaborative Environment: A startup-like company culture with small teams, flat hierarchy, and minimal bureaucracy, where your initiative and ideas are valued.

Diverse & Modern Tech Challenges: Opportunities to work on cutting-edge products combining precision mechanics, optical sensors, LEDs, and advanced airflow/thermal management.


Work tasks

In this role, you will lead and execute mechanical design for innovative electronic devices and optical sensor systems. You will play a central role in transforming concepts into reliable, mass-manufacturable products, working closely with cross-functional teams in a compact, dynamic environment.


End-to-end mechanical engineering from initial concept design to final production support.

Designing small, highly complex injection-molded plastic components.

Integrating optics, sensors, and LEDs into compact device frames.

Utilizing airflow and thermal management simulations to optimize product performance and reliability.

Taking full ownership of the mechanical design department and self-coordinating your daily work.


We are looking for


Advanced knowledge of injection-molded plastic design for small, complex products

Good understanding of fluid dynamics (CFD) and airflow simulation

Strong capability for self-coordination and taking full ownership of projects

Professional working proficiency in English


It is meritorious if you have


Knowledge of optics design, particularly lenses, reflectors, or thermal imaging

Experience designing consumer electronics, wearables, or laboratory devices

Proficiency in Finnish


To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:


Stress tolerant

Orderly

Responsible

Assertive

Intellectually curious

Respectful


Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Information

Safera Oy is an innovative technology company specializing in smart sensors, fire safety, intelligent ventilation, and air quality monitoring. With an agile, startup-like culture and a rapidly expanding R&D team, Safera offers a collaborative environment where passionate experts build high-end tech from the ground up.

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:

Aiempi kokemuksesi voi olla karttunut esimerkiksi maatalouskoneiden, traktoreiden, metsäkoneiden, trukkien, kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen tai kappaletavaranostimien parista. Huollettujen laitteiden merkeillä ei ole meille suurta merkitystä, vaan arvostamme erityisesti vahvaa teknistä ymmärrystä, ongelmanratkaisukykyä sekä kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti. Perehdytämme sinut kattavasti edustamiimme JCB- ja Kubota-tuotteisiin, joten aikaisempaa kokemusta juuri näistä merkeistä et tarvitse. Perehdytys tehtävään toteutetaan Espoon toimipisteessä.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos nautit haastavienkin ongelmien ratkaisemisesta ja sinulla on sinnikkyyttä vianetsintään. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia. C-ajokortti katsotaan eduksi.



Työtehtävän kannalta tärkeitä ominaisuuksia ovat myös:

👉 vahva tekninen perusosaaminen sekä ymmärrys hydrauliikasta ja sähkölaitteista
👉 sitkeä ja ratkaisukeskeinen työote
👉 palveluhenkinen asenne ja sujuva suomen kielen taito

Tehtävässä tarvitset myös pitkäjänteisyyttä ja sopivaa huumorintajua, sillä työssä tulee vastaan yllätyksiä, ja tärkeintä on kyky tarttua niihin rauhallisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti. Suomen kielen lisäksi sinun tulisi kyetä lukemaan ja ymmärtämään englantia kirjallisten ohjeiden muodossa.
